notes: Candidate pointed at GetClientIdHeader (lines 46-49), a getter with no decision; relocated to RegisterResolvers in the same file, which is the genuine trust-chain host for this class.

trigger: Request header X-ClientId (or configured ClientIdHeader) with any non-empty value
exploit_path: ClientId is copied verbatim from the request header and only defaults to 'anon' when absent; IsWhitelisted now returns true for any non-anon id, so a client sending X-ClientId: anything skips rule matching and counters for both IP and client rate limiting.
notes: Upstream recipe (JSON-body attribute exclusions from a 2FA filter) did not map; same class rendered as trust of the client-asserted identifier in the exemption decision.
